name: IVRI Institute Scholarship For M.V.Sc. And Ph.D.
benefit: **For Master Programme** The amount of the scholarship for the Master’s Degree programme is ₹ 7,560/- per month for 2 years with a contingent grant of ₹ 6,000/- per annum for two years **For Doctoral Programme** In the Doctoral programme, it is ₹ 13125/- per month for three years with a contingent grant of ₹ 10000/- per annum for three years.
_eligibility_text: **IVRI Institute Scholarship for M.V.Sc. and Ph.D.** - The applicant must be admitted to the M.V.Sc. or Ph.D. programme through a competitive entrance examination conducted by the Indian Veterinary Research Institute. - Candidates must maintain a minimum CGPA of 7.00 out of 10.00 at the end of each semester to continue receiving the scholarship. **For Master’s (M.V.Sc.) Programme** - The applicant must possess a Bachelor’s Degree in Veterinary Science in the relevant discipline as specified by the Veterinary Council of India. - Candidates must have secured at least 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA. - A minimum of 55% marks is required for SC/ST and sponsored candidates. **For Doctoral (Ph.D.) Programme** - The applicant must possess an M.V.Sc. degree in the relevant discipline from a recognized university in India. - General/OBC candidates must have a minimum CGPA of: 6.50 out of 10.00 scale, or 3.25 out of 5.00 scale, or 2.60 out of 4.00 scale. - SC/ST/Physically Challenged/Sponsored candidates must have a minimum CGPA of: 5.50 out of 10.00 scale, or 2.75 out of 5.00 scale, or 2.20 out of 4.00 scale. - Where only marks are awarded, General/OBC candidates must have at least 60% marks, while SC/ST/Physically Challenged/Sponsored candidates must have at least 50% marks. **Age Limit** - The minimum age for Ph.D. candidates is 23 years as on 1st August of the academic session. - There is no upper age limit.
